Dezember 1998 [AS 1999 1226, 2000 406, 2001 842, 2002 213 3050, 2003 5491, 2005 2545, 2006 893, 2007 1469 Anhang 4 Ziff. 57. AS 2008 3839 Art. 15 Ziff. 1].
